actual_providers_from_metadata: See generation-metadata.jsonl; never infer from the config file.
ingress: GVC2 WebSocket replay; source PTS retained; newest cached image no later than each 0.2-second tick; same JPEG bytes as previous tests. No new ACK gate or dropping policy.
time_reference: Primary delay: Windows frame send time to separate Windows worker receipt. Secondary PTS delay includes the source-frame selection age and sender scheduling delay.
clock_alignment: Before/after 7 HTTP clock probes, lowest RTT offset used for cross-host intermediate stages. Primary end-to-end metric does not need offset correction.
output_semantics: Raw four-event observations; observed_detected=true does not imply confirmed person alarm. Grounding lane remains active, GPU geometry is disabled.
limitations: One previously annotated demo video; three repetitions are not a representative accuracy benchmark.
Historical ~13.7 FPS tests also enabled GPU/SAM; changes versus those tests cannot all be attributed to upload frequency.
Full video includes cold starts; no trials or startup reports were discarded.
Configured VLM sampling remains unchanged; actual source intervals and report counts depend on timestamp gating, concurrency and expiration.
Stage percentiles have overlapping scopes and cannot be summed.
This replay sends without waiting for frame ACK and is not the production browser upload loop.
